verdict.rationale: Decagon's overview page says technical teams keep control over versioning, and Simulations validate agent behavior before deploying and with every later update, which is a pre-release review step. Neither is backed by detailed documentation, and nothing describes reverting an AOP or agent configuration to a prior version. Missing for 10: documented version history for AOPs/agent logic, a change-review or approval workflow, rollback to a previous version, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: technical teams retain full visibility and control over guardrails, integrations, and versioning
Simulations, Decagon's integrated testing suite, help teams validate agent behavior across channels before deploying to production and with every subsequent update.
